articles.title: European defence major MBDA signs pact with IAF to implement MRO capabilities for MICA missiles
articles.summary: The Indian Air Force (IAF) has partnered with European defence major MBDA to establish Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul (MRO) capabilities for its MICA missiles in India. This pact significantly boosts indigenous defence maintenance, reducing reliance on foreign vendors and enhancing the operational readiness of a vital air-to-air missile system. This aligns with India's 'Atmanirbhar Bharat' and 'Make in India' defence initiatives.

articles.title: To prepare for nuclear exigencies, DRDO opens CBRN centre in Delhi
articles.summary: The Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) has opened a Chemical, Biological, Radiological, and Nuclear (CBRN) centre in Delhi. This strategic move is aimed at bolstering India's preparedness and response capabilities for potential nuclear exigencies and other non-conventional threats. The facility will enhance national security infrastructure, ensuring a robust framework to handle unforeseen CBRN challenges effectively.

articles.title: Early-stage tech draws VC interest across aviation, biotech, precision manufacturing
articles.summary: Investors are strategically prioritizing early-stage deeptech startups, opting for smaller commitments in innovative sectors like AI and healthcare. This trend signifies a shift towards promising technological frontiers. For SSB aspirants, understanding these investment patterns is vital, as they indicate emerging technologies and economic growth drivers that will shape national development and future capabilities.

articles.title: French aircraft carrier pre-positions for possible Hormuz mission
articles.summary: France's aircraft carrier, the Charles de Gaulle, accompanied by its escort vessels, recently transited the strategic Suez Canal. This movement highlights the importance of naval power projection and freedom of navigation through critical global maritime choke points. Such deployments by major powers are significant for international security and demonstrate naval capabilities, relevant for understanding geopolitical dynamics.
